# Grafana

Plugin ID `grafana`. Links to dashboards.

With `plugins.grafana.url` set, an alert links to Grafana's alert list and the host on the Hardware
page links to Grafana. The plugin has no page and publishes nothing: it only offers links.

## What it shows

### Pages

No page of its own.

### Contributions

It contributes deep links on the objects other plugins show.

## Dependencies

A change to a plugin's settings restarts it and the plugins that require or use it.

- **Used by** [Alertmanager](alertmanager.md).

## Settings

Every setting is under `plugins.grafana` in the config file and is also in the [configuration reference](../configuration.md#pluginsgrafana), with the rules for all of them: the layers, the `_FILE` form of each variable and secret references. _Restart_ marks a setting that applies only when dash restarts; a change to any other restarts the plugin in place.

| Setting | Variable | Type | Default | Secret | Restart | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `plugins.grafana.type` | `DASH_PLUGINS_GRAFANA_TYPE` | string | - | no | no | The plugin type. dash runs one instance per type, so this is empty or the section name. |
| `plugins.grafana.enabled` | `DASH_PLUGINS_GRAFANA_ENABLED` | boolean | - | no | no | false turns the plugin off: its topics are removed, and the web UI drops its rail entry, palette entries, overview tiles and panels and shows a switched-off page at its address. Unset turns it on when it has the settings it needs (rustfs is off unless enabled: true, because nothing in its settings says an object store exists); a plugin without them is disabled ("not configured: set plugins.<id>.url", naming the setting to make) and the web UI hides its pages. true with settings missing or invalid makes it unconfigured, which hides its pages too. This is how prometheus, alertmanager, gatus, victorialogs, proxmox, hardware, ssh, kubernetes, flux, cnpg, rustfs, grafana, headlamp and launcher behave, and a change to any of their settings applies live: that plugin restarts, and so do the plugins that use or require it (a prometheus change restarts proxmox, hardware, kubernetes, cnpg and rustfs; a gatus change restarts hardware and kubernetes; a proxmox change restarts hardware; a kubernetes change restarts proxmox, flux and cnpg; a grafana change restarts alertmanager). |
| `plugins.grafana.url` | `DASH_PLUGINS_GRAFANA_URL` | string | - | no | no | Base URL of Grafana, e.g. https://grafana.example.com. Adds a link to Grafana's alert list on alerts and to Grafana on the host. Empty turns the Grafana links off. |

## Actions

None: the plugin only reads.

## Demo twin

With `DASH_DEMO=true` dash runs the plugin's demo twin instead: the same manifest, enabled and configured whatever the settings say, publishing made-up data from the fake lab in `internal/demo/world` and contacting nothing.
